description: Sets who each variant's email goes to, replacing its to, cc and bcc. Its other email settings, such as its sender and which runs send it, stay as copied from the template; a variant without email settings gets the defaults. Sends no email. As in the app, the burst's owner and admins can set any variant's recipients, other members only those of variants they own or can edit; the others are skipped, as is a variant with several recipient groups, which the app asks to reconcile first.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

variants.description: The variants whose recipients to replace, 1 to 500. The other variants, and the rest of each variant's email settings, stay as they are.

bcc.description: The addresses to also send the variant's email to without the other recipients seeing them. If omitted, no one is blind-copied.

cc.description: The addresses to copy on the variant's email, which every recipient can see. If omitted, no one is copied.

to.description: The addresses to send the variant's email to. If empty, no one receives it. At most 100 addresses across `to`, `cc` and `bcc`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: updateBurstVariantRecipients
